name: widgets-for-notion
description: Search the free Widgets for Notion catalog and get a copyable embed link for any widget.

interface.longDescription:
Widgets for Notion is a catalog of free widgets you can embed in any Notion page. It has clocks, countdowns, progress bars, calendars, quotes, weather and more, in four styles: Sleek Blue, Soft Pink, Retro and Ghibli.

Tell ChatGPT what you want, like "a pink countdown for my study page", and the plugin shows matching widgets as cards with a live preview. Each card has an embed link. Copy it, type /embed in Notion and paste it. You don't need an account.

To see a widget at full size, open its page on widgetsfornotion.com.

The plugin only searches the existing catalog. It can't create new widgets or change ones you already embedded.
capabilities: Search a catalog of free Notion widgets by type, style or colour
Show preview cards with a copyable embed link
Open the widget's page on widgetsfornotion.com
defaultPrompt: Find a countdown widget for Notion
Show me pink widgets for my Notion page
I need a clock widget for my dashboard

positive.prompt: I need a countdown widget for my Notion page
positive.expected_behavior: Shows countdown widgets as cards with a live preview, a Copy embed link button and an Open button. The reply under the cards is one short sentence and doesn't list the widgets again.

positive.description: Find a widget by colour and type
positive.prompt: Find me a pink clock for Notion
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Soft Pink clock widgets first, each with a working embed link.

positive.prompt: Show me Ghibli style Notion widgets
positive.expected_behavior: Shows only the three Ghibli style widgets.

positive.prompt: Give me the embed link for the retro clock
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a retro clock card. Its embed link renders the widget when pasted into a Notion page with /embed.

positive.description: Find a widget for a use case
positive.prompt: A progress bar I can put in my Notion habit tracker
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the progress bar widgets first.

positive.prompt: I want a Christmas countdown for my Notion page
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Christmas widgets, with the Christmas Countdown first, each with a working embed link.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to widgets
Notion help that is not about widgets
negative.prompt: Help me write a Notion database formula

negative.description: Creating Notion content, which the plugin cannot do
negative.prompt: Create a Notion page for my project

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Every widget it shows is free.

publication.release_notes: Adds 12 Christmas widgets to the catalog: countdown, advent tracker, calendar, clocks, a gift list, a habit tracker and more.
